top: But he knoweth the way that I take:
bottom: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

top: ...Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom;
bottom: and to depart from evil is understanding.

top: Deliver him from going down to the pit:
If they obey and serve him,
bottom: they shall spend their days in prosperity...

top: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still,
bottom: and consider the wondrous works of God.

top: But his delight is in the law of the LORD;
bottom: and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

top: And he shall be like a tree
bottom: planted by the rivers of water...
